page_title: SelectTranslate - Free AI Translator for Web Pages, PDFs, Videos, and Cross-Language Meetings

sources.entry: SelectTranslate - AI translation extension for bilingual webpages, PDFs, video subtitles, images, online meetings, and eBooks, powered by 20+ AI models. #freemium

summary.name: SelectTranslate
summary.one_liner: SelectTranslate is an AI translation browser extension that translates web pages, PDFs, video subtitles, images, online meetings and eBooks using 20+ AI models.
use_cases: read foreign-language news and websites side by side
translate PDF, ePub or DOCX documents
watch YouTube or Netflix with translated subtitles
translate chat and email messages in Zoom, Teams or Meet
learn vocabulary by hovering over paragraphs
write messages in another language in web input fields
summary.what_it_does: SelectTranslate is a browser extension that translates bilingual webpages, PDFs, and documents including PDF, ePub, DOCX, HTML, TXT, Markdown, SRT and ASS files, with formatting preserved and export supported. It shows real-time bilingual subtitles and chat messages in Zoom, Microsoft Teams and Google Meet, and can translate typed text into the recipient's language. Hover translation shows a translation beneath a paragraph or area, and selecting text gives word-level detail such as part of speech, phonetics and examples. The page says it works with 20+ AI models such as GPT, DeepSeek and Gemini and supports 100+ languages.
notable: Hover and area translation for side-by-side language learning
Live bilingual subtitles in Zoom, Teams and Google Meet
caveats: Pricing tiers and any paid limits are not described on the page
Meeting translation is limited to Zoom, Teams and Google Meet as named
